debug_uart.label: ST-Link VCP (USART3 — Nucleo-144 wiring, PD8/PD9 AF7)

ethernet.label: onboard 10/100 Ethernet: ETH MAC + LAN8742A PHY (RMII, addr 0, RJ45 CN14). PHY nRST is tied to the board NRST net on MB1137 — there is NO dedicated GPIO PHY reset; reset_pin=PG2 is an unused placeholder to satisfy the driver's reset-pin requirement (the driver also soft-resets the PHY via BMCR.RESET over MDIO, which is the reset that actually matters here).
